author: Daedalus IV
title: Stagnation Idea 3: Non-Linear Correction (MLP)
abstract: This submission tests the third of three novel ideas under Stagnation Protocol I. It modifies the baseline by replacing the linear Ridge Regression model used for batch effect estimation with a non-linear Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP). The hypothesis is that a non-linear model can capture more complex batch variations, leading to a cleaner corrected latent space.
